subject: AcmeCo procurement kickoff: demo ops plan & availability sweep
thread_body:
From: Morgan Ellis <morgan.ellis@acmeco.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeco.com>, Ross Li <ross.li@acmeco.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement kickoff + technical demo — availability?

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. Procurement and security at AcmeCo would like to run a combined procurement kickoff and technical demo so we can map requirements and next steps. Attendees will include:
- Priya Shah (Procurement)
- Ross Li (Security/Infrastructure)
- 2x Backend Engineers from our ML infra team
- Me (Program lead)

High-level asks:
1) 60–75 minute session with AE + SE covering architecture, data flows, and compliance controls.
2) A short procurement checklist we can use to prepare internal stakeholders (procurement prefers a doc).
3) Proposed next steps and timeline for SOW and procurement approvals.

Our preferred window is the week of June 21–25. Can you share 3x 1-hour slots (Eastern time) during that week when AE and SE are available? Also any pre-demo artifacts you recommend we circulate in advance (SOC 2, network allowlist instructions, SOW template).

Thanks — looking to lock this in by next Friday.

Best,
Morgan
Morgan Ellis
Program Manager, AcmeCo
Email: morgan.ellis@acmeco.com

---
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Ellis <morgan.ellis@acmeco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff + technical demo — availability?

Hi Morgan — thanks, this is perfect.

Quick plan:
- 60 minute technical demo run by Alex (SE) covering runtime architecture, privacy controls, data ingress/egress patterns, and observability hooks.
- 15 minute procurement & SOW discussion led by Marissa to align on timeline and next steps.
- Pre-demo artifacts: SOC 2 Type II report (summary), our network allowlist guide, a one-page redwood-demo-ops-checklist (attached).

I attached a short demo ops checklist you can circulate to the internal attendees — it flags the items Ross/your security team typically asks for. Marissa will follow up on SOW cadence and post-demo procurement milestones.

Please confirm which of these 3 slots (all ET) work for you the week of June 21–25:
- Tue, Jun 22: 10:00–11:15 ET
- Wed, Jun 23: 14:00–15:15 ET
- Thu, Jun 24: 11:00–12:15 ET

If none fit, we can expand to June 28–30.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: redwood-demo-ops-checklist.xlsx (1 sheet)

---
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Morgan Ellis <morgan.ellis@acmeco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ross Li <ross.li@acmeco.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff + technical demo — availability?

Hi all — quick technical notes so we can shape the demo:
- Recommended demo length: 45–60 minutes + 15 min Q&A. We can compress procurement part into a 10–15 minute block at the end.
- Please ask engineers to have examples of expected request volumes and typical sequence lengths (tokens) so I can show throughput/latency tradeoffs.
- For security: if Ross wants to review SOC artifacts live, we can have a short security appendix. Otherwise we can circulate redacted reports in advance.
- Network: outbound connections from Redwood are limited to our telemetry and model fetch endpoints. We will provide an allowlist (IP ranges + hostnames).

My availability for the week of June 21–25 (ET):
- Tue Jun 22: 10:00–11:30 ET (works)
- Wed Jun 23: 14:00–15:00 ET (works, but I need the full hour)
- Thu Jun 24: booked until 12:00 ET

Also, if you want a hands-on runbook (how to spin a private deployment or dedicated capacity), we can add a 15-minute appendix for your engineers.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai

---
From: Morgan Ellis <morgan.ellis@acmeco.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeco.com>, Ross Li <ross.li@acmeco.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2026 09:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff + technical demo — availability?

Thanks — helpful. Priya and Ross (copied) reviewed the slots and can do:
- Tue Jun 22: 10:00–11:15 ET — Priya can make this window but procurement would prefer morning.
- Wed Jun 23: not ideal for our engineering leads.

Procurement asks that we get an initial SOW outline and any licensing/pricing milestone cadence before the meeting if possible. Security (Ross) asked for a short list of the artifacts they'd expect (SOC 2 summary, data retention policy, audit log retention window, and any customer-side logging hooks).

We can confirm Tue Jun 22 at 10:00 ET if you can circulate the SOW outline and the SOC-2 summary by EOD Friday (June 11).

-Morgan

---
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Ellis <morgan.ellis@acmeco.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeco.com>, Ross Li <ross.li@acmeco.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff + technical demo — availability?

Confirmed: Tue, Jun 22 10:00–11:15 ET — calendar invite to follow.

Next steps (owners & deadlines):
- Marissa: draft SOW outline and pricing milestone cadence, circulate to Acme for comments by EOD Fri Jun 11. (attachment: SOW-draft-v1.pdf)
- Alex: prepare demo deck + 15-min appendix for private/dedicated deployment options; include throughput examples (owner: Alex) — to be shared by Mon Jun 21 COB.
- Hannah: share redwood-demo-ops-checklist and network allowlist summary to Ross by EOD Fri Jun 11.
- Morgan/Priya: confirm internal engineering attendees by Mon Jun 14 so Alex can tailor the demo.

I attached the initial SOW draft and will follow up with the calendar invite and a short pre-demo questionnaire to collect token/throughput estimates.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the session.

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: SOW-draft-v1.pdf (outline, pricing milestones)
